# The expectation floor: the test functions each of these modules must keep declaring.
# packages/tools/tests/test_editing_invariants.py holds each module to this floor.
#
# Scope: the suites of reader.py, snapshot.py, differ.py, session.py, writer/ and
# validator/, where "adjust the test rather than the code" is available. The
# sibling xfail and skip checks cover the whole legacy inventory and need no fixture.
#
# Format: a module path at column 0, its test functions tab-indented under it,
# class-qualified with `::`. A change that deliberately renames or retires an
# expectation edits this file in the same commit, whose message says why: a rename
# keeps its claim, and a retirement names its successor or states the coverage it loses.
